name: formcel
description: Find, read and run the commands of the FormCel spreadsheet window on this computer: every menu and ribbon action is a command with an id.
long_description: FormCel is the Form family's spreadsheet app. This extension is a stdio bridge to the FormCel engine's MCP endpoint on 127.0.0.1. Start FormCel with ./formcel or open the app first; the bridge also tries to start the engine when it can. The first command an outside agent runs asks the person once, in the FormCel window, to allow outside agents.

engine_url.title: Engine address
engine_url.description: The FormCel engine's MCP address on this computer.
